categories.main_business_segments: The company primarily operates in the nonwoven fabric industry, producing and selling nonwoven materials, ES composite short fibers, and nonwoven material products. The company's main business segments include water-jet nonwoven fabrics, hot-air nonwoven fabrics, super-fine fiber nonwoven fabrics, meltblown nonwoven fabrics, and degradable nonwoven fabrics. These products are used in hygiene materials (civil cleaning and medical), decorative materials, and industrial applications.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company utilizes advanced water-jet technology, hot-air technology, and meltblown spinning technology for nonwoven fabric production. Core technologies include self-developed low-shrinkage high-temperature synthetic leather base fabric, 45g/m² low-weight synthetic leather base fabric, and double-sided heterogeneous hot-air nonwoven fabric. The company employs customized production equipment with optimized process parameters and has developed proprietary equipment selection systems for nonwoven production.
categories.primary_customers_markets: The company serves diverse customer groups across multiple industries including hygiene materials manufacturers, daily consumer goods companies, leather processing, apparel, building materials, and packaging sectors. Key customers include Hengan Group, Vinda Paper, Shanghai Meixin Hygiene Products, Hangzhou Haoyue, and Japanese LEC. Products are sold domestically across most Chinese provinces and exported primarily to Japan, South Korea, and other international markets.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates primarily in China with its headquarters and main production facilities in Chuzhou, Anhui Province. It has established subsidiaries including Chuzhou Gold Clean Hygiene Materials Technology Co., Ltd., Luzhou Jinchun Nonwoven Co., Ltd., Jinchun Medical Hygiene Materials (Chuzhou) Co., Ltd., and Tingmei Import-Export (Chuzhou) Co., Ltd. The company has domestic sales coverage across most Chinese provinces and international presence in Japan, South Korea, and other markets.
categories.supply_chain_position: The company operates in the midstream of the nonwoven fabric industry supply chain. Upstream suppliers include raw material producers (polyester staple fiber, viscose staple fiber, polyester chips, nylon chips, polypropylene) and equipment manufacturers. Downstream customers include nonwoven product manufacturers and end-market consumers in hygiene materials, decorative materials, and industrial applications.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company prioritizes continuous technology innovation and product quality improvement, focusing on developing differentiated and high-value-added nonwoven products. Strategic initiatives include developing degradable nonwoven fabrics using eco-friendly materials, advancing super-fine fiber technology, optimizing production processes for efficiency, and expanding applications in high-performance hygiene and industrial sectors. The company maintains an academy-industry cooperation station and enterprise technology center.
categories.revenue_model: The company generates revenue primarily through direct sales of nonwoven fabric materials and products to downstream manufacturers. Revenue is recognized when customers complete product verification and acceptance. The company employs a make-to-order production model with customized specifications. Secondary revenue comes from ES composite short fiber sales and nonwoven material products. The company also generates minor revenue from equipment leasing.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: The company is positioned as a leading specialized nonwoven fabric manufacturer in China with significant scale and technical capabilities. It is a vice-chairman unit of the China Industrial Textile Association and was recognized as a 'specialized and innovative' SME in 2020 and among the top 10 nonwoven fabric enterprises in China for 2020-2021. The company competes on product quality, customization capabilities, and supply reliability rather than price alone.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: The company achieved 2024 revenue of 1,032.41 million yuan, representing 14.65% growth from 2023's 900.47 million yuan. Net profit attributable to shareholders was 30.94 million yuan in 2024, up 2.20% from 2023. The company maintains total assets of 1,820.52 million yuan and shareholders' equity of 1,579.48 million yuan as of December 31, 2024. Operating cash flow improved significantly to 35.61 million yuan in 2024 from 11.82 million yuan in 2023.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: The company differentiates through advanced production technology, customized product development capabilities, and consistent quality. Key competitive advantages include proprietary equipment optimization, differentiated product designs (such as low-shrinkage high-temperature synthetic leather base fabric and degradable nonwoven fabrics), comprehensive product portfolio serving multiple industries, and established brand reputation. The company emphasizes environmental sustainability through degradable product development and energy-efficient production processes.
